text:
ConocoPhillips fell 1.66% today after oil prices dropped for a second day on hopes for a diplomatic resolution to the Iran conflict. The stock had jumped $4 on Friday following escalating tensions, but crude retreated sharply yesterday and again today as U.S. and Iranian leadership signaled openness to negotiations, easing the geopolitical premium that had pushed prices higher.

The broader headwind for oil majors is the election outcome: Democrats are poised to sweep Congress, which typically favors renewable energy investment over fossil fuels and could create longer-term pressure on oil demand expectations. Combined with the immediate relief rally in oil prices, this created a two-punch backdrop for the pullback today.
